chapters.label: Nizhny Novgorod, 2018
chapters.text: Nizhny Novgorod, 2018, a World Cup quarter-final. France against Uruguay. Antoine Griezmann stands over a free kick on the right. He stops, curls it in... Raphaël Varane glances it home!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Griezmann checks his run. The ball bends in towards goal. Varane times his run from deep and gets there first.

chapters.label: The glance
chapters.text: From beside the post, see his forehead flick it. The ball skims into the bottom corner. France lead, one–nil!

chapters.label: Time your run
chapters.text: At a free kick, time your run. Attack the ball with your forehead. Glance it to the far corner.
